Veeam Backup & Replication

Backup, replication and recovery

What it does, in motion

  • Restore points are created on a schedule
  • Copies go to a local, an immutable and a cloud repository
  • Ransomware encrypts production and the newest points
  • A clean point is chosen and the VM starts straight from backup

Illustrative simulation of a typical scenario. Not live data.

How it works, step by step in 3D

  1. Protect A backup job takes image-level restore points of each workload.
  2. Store Restore points are kept in a hardened repository so they cannot be altered.
  3. Copy and verify A further copy goes offsite or offline (the 3-2-1 rule) and backup data is checked for ransomware signs.
  4. Recover Choose a clean restore point and restore, or start the machine directly from backup.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data. Drag to look around, or use the step buttons.

What it is

Backup and recovery software for virtual, physical and cloud workloads. It takes image-level restore points, replicates workloads, and can start a failed machine directly from backup.

Security

  • Immutable and hardened repositories so backups cannot be altered
  • 3-2-1 copy strategy: three copies, two media, one offsite or offline
  • Encryption of backup data and role-based access

AI direction

  • Malware and anomaly detection on backup data to spot ransomware activity
  • Helps choose a clean restore point after an attack
  • Automation of recovery testing and reporting
